title: Slack
description: Post messages to Slack channels and list the channels a bot can see, through Slack's Web API with a bot token.
setup_notes: Create a Slack app at api.slack.com/apps, add the bot scopes chat:write and channels:read, install it to your workspace, and copy the Bot User OAuth Token (it starts with xoxb-). Invite the bot to each channel it should post in (/invite @yourbot). The credential lands disabled: test and enable it under API Credentials, then approve the tools under Persistent Tools.

questions.name: bot_token
questions.label: Slack bot token
questions.help: The Bot User OAuth Token, starting with xoxb-. It is stored in the credential's secret store and never written into a tool.
